The `== 85.5` line also contradicts the test's own `== 85.0` assertion and the README spec. The frozen tests must not be modified (per README), so this contradiction cannot be resolved by any legitimate implementation. Requesting a review/decision on ticket #212's contradictory assertion before the release cut.
